items.summary_en: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It ships with five diagram types, four presets, light/dark themes, and Before/Delta/After snapshots for reviewing architecture changes before merge.

items.title: 如何把 Agent 的判断与行动变成可恢复的软件事实 | KDC 工程补篇
items.summary_zh: vivo 肖博撰文探讨如何让 Agent 的判断与行动成为可恢复、可控制、可审计的软件事实。文章区分领域现实、业务判断事实和软件运行事实，提出业务因果链与运行事实链的“双链”结构，并将 Session、Harness 与执行环境解耦，引入 Resume、Progress、Evaluation 三类 Contract 来管理恢复、交接与验证。
items.summary_en: Written by vivo's Xiao Bo, this KDC companion piece addresses how to make agent reasoning and actions recoverable, controllable, and auditable. It separates domain reality, business judgment facts, and runtime facts, proposing a dual-chain structure (business causal chain and runtime fact chain) and decoupling Session, Harness, and execution environment. Three contracts — Resume, Progress, Evaluation — govern recovery, handover, and validation of agent runs.

items.title: Flux 推出 Mirror 插件：只让可信制品进入 Kubernetes 集群
items.summary_zh: Flux Mirror 是 Flux 推出的 CLI 插件，按声明式配置在注册表间镜像容器镜像、Helm Chart 和 OCI 制品，并用 Cosign 校验签名和最短存续时间，防止不可信制品进入集群。它能降低 Docker Hub 限流、Bitnami 目录冻结等上游策略突变带来的风险，适合以 OCI 为期望状态来源的无 Git GitOps 团队。
items.summary_en: Flux Mirror is a new CLI plugin from Flux that declaratively mirrors container images, Helm charts, and OCI artifacts between registries. It enforces Cosign signatures and a minimum age policy, so only trusted artifacts can reach Kubernetes clusters. The plugin also addresses risks like Docker Hub rate limits and the Bitnami catalog freeze, making it useful for teams running Gitless GitOps on OCI-based desired state.

items.summary_en: Microsoft has made Azure DevOps Remote MCP Server generally available, providing a hosted endpoint for AI assistants to reach work items, pull requests, repos, and pipelines without local setup. Authentication uses Entra ID, which currently blocks Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor because those clients can't do Entra's dynamic OAuth client registration or client ID metadata documents. Only Microsoft's own clients, like VS Code with GitHub Copilot, work for now.

items.title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.author: ComputerGuru
items.summary_zh: 逆向工程发现，Microsoft Paint 和 Photos 都会在本地生成的 AI 图像像素中嵌入一个服务器下发的 GUID，作为不可见水印。也就是说，虽然是在本地生成，输出也可能带有可追溯的隐藏标识；对隐私敏感的用户和做内容溯源的人影响直接。
items.summary_en: A reverse-engineering look shows that Microsoft Paint and Photos embed a server-issued GUID into the pixels of AI images produced locally, forming an invisible watermark. Local generation therefore doesn't guarantee an untraceable file. The finding matters for privacy-conscious users and for anyone researching AI-content provenance, though only the mechanism has been confirmed so far.

items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

items.summary_en: Airi is a self-hosted AI companion inspired by Grok and Neuro-sama, designed to give users full ownership of their virtual digital soul. It runs locally, offering customizable chat, emotional simulation, and extensible capabilities. Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a privacy-respecting, personalized digital companion can use Airi to experiment with AI personalities, integrate with other systems, and create unique interactive experiences, all while keeping data on their own hardware.

items.title: dotnet/aspnetcore
items.description: ASP.NET Core is a cross-platform .NET framework for building modern cloud-based web applications on Windows, Mac, or Linux.
items.author: dotnet
items.summary_zh: dotnet/aspnetcore 是 ASP.NET Core 这个跨平台 .NET 框架所在的仓库，用于在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上构建现代云端 Web 应用。它登上 GitHub 趋势榜，是 .NET Web 开发者的基础参照；跨平台支持让非 Windows 环境的开发与部署更现实。
items.summary_en: The dotnet/aspnetcore repo is the repository for ASP.NET Core, a cross-platform .NET framework for building modern cloud-based web applications on Windows, Mac, or Linux. It is currently trending on GitHub, making it a timely reference for .NET web developers. Its cross-platform support matters for teams that don't want to lock into Windows-only hosting.

items.title: alibaba/page-agent
items.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
items.author: alibaba
items.summary_zh: alibaba/page-agent 是一个 JavaScript 实现的页内 GUI 代理，能够用自然语言指令操控网页界面。它直接运行在页面内，省去浏览器扩展或外部驱动的额外依赖，适合做网页自动化与 AI 助手原型。仓库目前只有简短介绍，具体用法需以 README 为准。
items.summary_en: alibaba/page-agent is a JavaScript in-page GUI agent that lets you control web interfaces with natural language. Running directly inside the page, it avoids the need for browser extensions or external drivers, making it a convenient starting point for web automation and AI-assisted browsing. The repository only ships a brief description, so check the README for implementation details.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.
items.author: stablyai
items.summary_zh: stablyai/orca 是一个面向并行 agent 集群的 ADE，官方介绍称可以用自己的订阅运行任意编码 agent，并支持桌面、移动端和 VPS。它试图把多个 agent 的调度、运行集中到一个工具里，适合需要同时跑多个编码任务的开发者。仓库详情不多，具体工作方式需看 README。
items.summary_en: stablyai/orca is an ADE (agent development environment) for working with a fleet of parallel agents. According to the description, you can run any coding agent with your own subscription, on desktop, mobile, or a VPS. It's aimed at developers who want a single tool to coordinate multiple coding agents, though the repository listing is light on specifics.
